name: adequation_result
description: Schema for regulatory prospect adequation result with one or more rules applied

prospect_filename.description: Name of the prospect file being modified

disposition_id.description: Unique identifier for the disposition (e.g., ANMAT_7572_2006)

title.description: Full title of the disposition or circular

rule_result.description: Array of rule application results (usually 1 per call)

rule_id.description: Numeric identifier of the rule being applied

input_version.description: Version number of the prospect before applying this rule

output_version.description: Version number of the prospect after applying this rule

status_before.description: Compliance status before applying the rule

status_after.description: Compliance status after attempting to apply the rule

section_selected.description: Name of the prospect section where changes were made or would be made

rationale.description: Brief explanation of the decision made and changes applied

changes.description: List of specific changes made to the prospect text

location_hint.description: Human-readable description of where the change was made

before_snippet.description: Short excerpt of text before the change (empty if insertion)

after_snippet.description: Short excerpt of text after the change (empty if deletion)

updated_prospect_text.description: Full prospect text after applying this rule
Final prospect text for this disposition (same as last rule_result item)

summary.description: Summary statistics for this adequation response

rules_in_payload.description: Number of rules included in this response

already_compliant.description: Number of rules that were already compliant

conflict.description: Number of rules that could not be applied due to conflicts or missing information

not_applicable.description: Number of rules that do not apply to this prospect
